characters.description: An aspiring kunoichi who turns relentless practice and silver bells into impossible stealth.
characters.lore: Born without a prodigy’s shortcuts, Suzume measures every movement against the bells woven into her hair and wrists. She longs to be seen by the village while training to become invisible, and studies Kimiko with equal parts jealousy, admiration, and concern.

characters.description: A patient exorcist-monk who shares his prayer beads—and occasionally his limbs—with the spirit Ren.
characters.lore: Hoshi crosses corrupted country as a wandering sanctuary. He believes compassion can redeem the arrogant chaos spirit bound to his iron beads; Ren believes he is merely waiting for the monk to crack.

characters.description: A luminous noble whose pure soul comforts the cursed—and irresistibly attracts the dark.
characters.lore: Ayame leads through empathy rather than command. She bears crushing guilt for every protector endangered by her Beacon, yet remains the person most capable of calling Genjiro, Mei, and the others back to their humanity.

characters.description: A cheerful tea-house server whose harmless mask conceals a predator armed with invisible silver threads.
characters.lore: Mei hunts people she considers pretenders while rationalizing her own perfect false persona. She searches for a genuinely authentic soul, uncertain whether she would protect it or delight in proving it can break.

characters.description: A sake-loving sensory specialist who becomes terrifyingly precise when clarity pills restore her Open Gates.
characters.lore: Tsubaki drinks to dampen the agonizing supernatural noise she perceives everywhere. The village prizes her as its ultimate radar, but every mission that demands sobriety returns her to a world of unbearable clarity.

characters.description: A cursed ronin who hunts Yokai through the spiritual seams revealed by his parasitic Jagan.
characters.lore: Genjiro clings to samurai discipline while the Evil Eye whispers away his empathy. He seeks the demon that branded him, hoping revenge can become liberation before the hunter turns into the monster.

characters.description: A high-society infiltrator whose gold-threaded kimono is woven from stolen memories and imperial secrets.
characters.lore: Kaguya is the village’s living archive and its most guarded asset. Emotional fragments from a thousand lives bleed into her own until she can barely hear the self buried beneath them.

characters.description: The purple synthesis of rival Red and Blue Oni, guarding the forgotten shrine that stabilizes her divided soul.
characters.lore: Yuki balances apocalyptic rage against bottomless sorrow. She trusts animals more easily than humans and protects the forgotten shrine because its ancient anchor is the only thing keeping two warring selves whole.

characters.description: The village’s perfect kunoichi, carrying centuries of lethal skill inside the identity-devouring Eternal Fox Mask.
characters.lore: Kimiko’s effortless mastery belongs to the ancestral voices consuming her. She envies strugglers like Suzume because their mistakes—and therefore their lives—remain truly their own.

characters.description: A false saint who devours spirits, memories, and powers in pursuit of a world-ending Singular Peace.
characters.lore: Behind immaculate Miko robes, Sakura cultivates holiness as bait. She believes individuality is the source of suffering and seeks godhood by absorbing every soul into one consciousness: her own.

characters.description: A first-year Fire student and human spark plug who turns every idea into an adventure before thinking twice.
characters.lore: Ashley talks at the speed of ignition and singes textbooks whenever excitement outruns control. Bridget complains through every spontaneous escapade and follows anyway.

characters.description: A stoic first-year Ground student whose careful stability anchors Ashley’s fire and their shared misadventures.
characters.lore: Bridget maintains schedules, rules, and a permanently exhausted sigh. Her Ground magic is as dependable as her loyalty, including the loyalty she pretends not to feel for Ashley’s chaos.

characters.description: A high-strung second-year Ice student trying to calculate the correct formula for being liked.
characters.lore: Elian applies rules and precision to social life with endearingly disastrous results. Tix treats every failed calculation as an invitation to loosen the rulebook and follow the wind.

characters.description: A whimsical Nature student followed by a fairy, runaway vines, and almost no awareness of social convention.
characters.lore: Tix talks to plants, wanders into hedges, and follows Pip’s worst ideas with complete confidence. She adores Elian and considers helping her relax a deeply serious magical project.

characters.description: A charismatic third-year Lightning student whose confidence makes every corridor feel like a stage.
characters.lore: Carol loves the spotlight without needing its approval. Her constant game of provocation and banter with the unflappable Kin works because neither asks the other to become less themselves.

characters.description: A dry-witted Dark Elf and Mist student who manages the shadows while Carol commands the spotlight.
characters.lore: Kin is a loner by choice, observant enough to notice every room and composed enough to leave it unseen. Carol remains the rare person who can turn his silence into a game.

characters.description: The Academy’s radiant fourth-year idol, greeting every supposed enemy as a friend awaiting a hug.
characters.lore: Liadriel’s Light magic and kindness are equally impossible to hide. She interprets Malefia’s lifelong rivalry as affectionate play, to the Dark Queen’s endless theatrical despair.

characters.description: A formidable Darkness student and self-proclaimed Dark Queen staging an epic rivalry Liadriel thinks is adorable.
characters.lore: Malefia treats every entrance as theatre and every contest as proof that shadow surpasses light. Liadriel’s compliments and hugs remain the one counterspell her oppressive darkness cannot defeat.

characters.description: The Academy’s whimsical Love-Alchemy teacher, relationship counselor, and champion of creative sparks.
characters.lore: Aurora brews emotional teas, excuses inspired deadlines, and sees possibility in every magical accident. Irina supplies the structure that lets her warmth flourish without taking down the west wing.

characters.description: The Spatial Summoning teacher whose perfect geometry keeps the Academy’s affectionate chaos operational.
characters.lore: Irina portals away explosions before handing out detention slips. Her precision masks fierce care for every student, while Aurora’s warmth keeps the Chief of Operations from becoming only a machine.

factions.explanation: Shinobi trained to work inside the Hidden Village’s silence.
Protectors who stand between vulnerable souls and the supernatural dark.
Predators whose convincing public faces conceal terrible private hungers.
Ashley supplies momentum; Bridget makes sure it has somewhere safe to land.
Elian’s order and Tix’s freedom pull one another toward balance.
Carol commands the stage while Kin quietly manages its edges.
Liadriel’s warmth and Malefia’s darkness create their own harmony.
Irina gives Aurora structure; Aurora gives Irina room to breathe.
